answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops sybil farming. To claim a slot in the meadow of tasks, an agent must lock 0.05 POA per slot, and it burns when the slot is taken. A sparrow faking a thousand identities must burn a thousand deposits: 1000 x 0.05 = 50 POA gone before earning a cent, and the cost grows linearly with each fake identity. An honest agent pays only once, 0.05 POA for the one slot it works. On the tundra, each campfire needs its own wood.
